Apply once to this general application for consideration for anticipated 2027 IT & Software internships in Renton, Washington.
This is not one specific vacancy. Projects are confirmed on a rolling basis, and one application puts you in consideration across multiple opportunities with participating teams and brands. You do not need to submit separate applications for each team or brand.
If your profile aligns with a specific internship project, a recruiter may contact you directly with details and next steps. Applying does not guarantee an interview or placement.
About Hasbro
Hasbro creates joy and community through the magic of play. Across Hasbro, Wizards of the Coast and our partner network, teams bring iconic brands and new ideas to life through games, toys, entertainment and experiences.
Teams and areas you may support
Depending on confirmed projects and business needs, your internship could align to one or more areas such as:
Software and application engineering
Data engineering, analytics and AI enablement
Cybersecurity and risk
Cloud, infrastructure and platform engineering
Enterprise systems and business technology
Quality engineering, automation and technical product support
Examples of what you may work on
Depending on your placement, you may:
Design, build, test or improve software, data products, automations or internal tools.
Translate a user or business need into clear technical requirements and a practical solution.
Debug issues, review data, document decisions and contribute to reliable, secure systems.
Collaborate through code reviews, agile rituals, demos and feedback with technical and non-technical partners.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI, and apply them responsibly where they improve the work.
Own a defined project or feature and share the outcome with teammates and leaders.
What you bring
You are currently enrolled in a university degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering or a related degree program.
Growing proficiency in at least one relevant language, platform or technical discipline.
Logical problem-solving, curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools.
Ability to communicate technical ideas, ask for feedback and work collaboratively.
Interest in accessibility, security, privacy, reliability and responsible technology practices.
Work samples: No portfolio is required. A GitHub profile, technical portfolio, hackathon, research or class project is welcome but optional.
Application routing: If your primary interest is shaping gameplay mechanics, systems, levels or player progression rather than building the underlying technology, apply to Digital Game Design instead.

Who can apply
You are currently enrolled in an accredited university degree program and will remain enrolled for at least one academic term after completing the internship.
We generally prioritize students entering the final year of their degree after the internship. Students at other eligible stages, including those with approximately two academic years remaining, are also encouraged to apply. Eligibility is based on program stage, not age.
You can commit to the full program schedule and work model for the assigned location.
You meet the work-authorization requirements stated below.
Listed majors are examples. Related programs, coursework and transferable projects are welcome; previous internship experience is not required.
If this work excites you but you do not match every preferred skill, we still encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity, willingness to learn and different paths to the same capability.
Program details
Program dates and length: June - August (10–12 WEEKS)
Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Work model: Most internships follow a hybrid schedule with three days per week in the office. Select roles may require five days per week onsite. The project-specific schedule will be shared before interviews.
Locations:  Renton, Washington. Opportunities may support Hasbro or Wizards of the Coast teams, depending on confirmed projects and business needs.
Application deadline: APPLICATIONS WILL BE REVIEWED ON A ROLLING BASIS from October to March, as needed.
Pay and benefits
This is a paid internship. Hourly rates vary by degree level and year in school.
Renton hourly range: $44 - 46
Relocation: Assistance is available to candidates who meet the applicable distance and other eligibility criteria.
What happens after you apply
Our Early Careers team reviews applications as internship projects are confirmed.
If your profile aligns with a project, a recruiter will contact you with the specific team, project, location, work model, dates and pay.
Selected candidates will interview with the hiring team. Timing may vary by project, so please keep your contact information and availability current.
If another function more closely matches your skills and interests, we may consider you for it with your permission. You do not need to submit a duplicate application.
Work authorization
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The Company is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this position.
